sixers: Verified: the Sixers traded Paul George plus two firsts and two seconds to Boston for Jaylen Brown (agreed July 1, 2026) and signed LeBron James to a two-year deal (July 24; ESPN reported about $8M). Joel Embiid (healthy, 'ready to go' per Nick Nurse), Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe (2025-26 ROY finalist) are still the core, and Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope were added. Lost: Paul George (BOS), Quentin Grimes (LAL), Kelly Oubre Jr. (IND), Andre Drummond (NYK), Jared McCain (traded to OKC Feb 2026). Ariel Hukporti tore his Achilles in preseason. Last season: 45-37, beat Orlando in the play-in, came back from 3-1 down to beat Boston (first series win over the Celtics since 1982), then got swept by the eventual champion Knicks. 2026-27: a franchise-record 34 national TV games, Nick Nurse coaching.

notes.schedule_check: All 40 dates and tip times match ESPN's Sixers schedule (checked 2026-10-20). No changes found.
notes.home_game_41: The Inquirer counts 41 home games. The 41st isn't on the list yet: every team has two games still to be scheduled between Dec 4 and Dec 10, and the NBA sets them from the NBA Cup group results. Expect one more December home date to appear.
notes.nba_cup: Sixers are in East Group B (Knicks, Cavaliers, Heat, Pacers). Their home Cup group games are Oct 30 vs NYK and Nov 25 vs MIA. Away: Nov 6 at CLE, Nov 27 at IND.
notes.cheapest_at_launch: Per the Inquirer, only six home games opened at the $75 upper-deck base price: Nov 2 CHI, Nov 12 TOR, Dec 1 MEM, Jan 12 WAS, Jan 25 LAC, Apr 4 ATL. The home opener and the Knicks games started at $320.
notes.national_tv_home: Oct 22 ESPN, Oct 30 Prime, Nov 10 NBC, Nov 25 ESPN, Dec 23 Prime, Jan 6 ESPN, Jan 8 ESPN, Jan 12 NBC, Feb 5 Prime, Feb 7 NBC, Feb 11 Prime, Mar 4 Prime, Mar 15 Peacock, Mar 21 NBC, Mar 31 ESPN. NBA TV: Oct 24, Dec 2, Dec 17.
notes.back_to_backs_rest_risk: These home games are one night of a Sixers back-to-back, so Embiid or LeBron could rest: Oct 24/25, Nov 15 (at BKN next night), Dec 1/2, Jan 19 (at ATL the day before), Feb 7/8, Mar 3/4, Mar 8 (at BOS the day before), Mar 17 (at WAS next night). That's why no hook depends on Embiid playing.
notes.confidence_key: high = verified fact that doesn't depend on a player's health months out; medium = verified, but the hook depends on an injury-prone or far-off player actually suiting up; low = unverified (none used).

2026-10-22.hook: Home opener: LeBron vs. his old Cavs
2026-10-22.alt: LeBron's first home game as a Sixer
2026-10-22.basis: NBA schedule release: LeBron makes his Philadelphia home debut vs. Cleveland on Oct 22 (ESPN). He played for the Cavs 2003-10 and 2014-18, and he wasn't on the Sixers' Oct 19 injury report. The Cavs (Mitchell, Mobley, ex-Sixer James Harden) made the East finals last season.

2026-10-24.alt: First home Saturday of the LeBron era
2026-10-24.basis: The Bucks traded Giannis to Miami in June 2026 and got Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and picks. This is the Sixers' first Saturday home game. NBA TV.

2026-10-25.hook: Cade's Pistons, last year's East No. 1
2026-10-25.basis: The Pistons went 60-22 as the East's No. 1 seed in 2025-26 (lost to CLE in the second round), led by Cade Cunningham. Second night of a Sixers back-to-back.

2026-10-30.hook: Champion Knicks, our NBA Cup opener
2026-10-30.alt: Payback for May's sweep, Friday night
2026-10-30.basis: The Knicks won the 2026 title (4-1 over the Spurs) after sweeping the Sixers 4-0 in the East semis. Oct 30 is the Sixers' first NBA Cup group game (East Group B), on Prime Video. Ex-Sixer Andre Drummond comes back with the Knicks.

2026-11-02.basis: The Bulls took Caleb Wilson (UNC) No. 4 in the 2026 draft and also have Giddey, Buzelis and Norman Powell. One of six $75-base games at launch. Alt is medium because it depends on a rookie playing.

2026-11-10.hook: PG back in Philly as a Celtic
2026-11-10.basis: PG went to Boston in the Jaylen Brown trade. NBC Sports Philadelphia calls Nov 10 the first trip to Philly for PG and the Celtics (regular season; they played a preseason game here Oct 16). The Sixers beat Boston 4-3 from 3-1 down in the 2026 first round. National TV on NBC.

2026-11-12.alt: Thursday night vs. Kawhi and Scottie
2026-11-12.basis: The Clippers traded Kawhi Leonard back to Toronto this summer (Brandon Ingram and Gradey Dick went to LA). He scored 21 in his preseason debut Oct 13. The Raptors were the East's No. 5 seed last season. Medium because Kawhi often sits.

2026-11-15.hook: Sunday matinee, Oubre's back with Indy
2026-11-15.basis: Kelly Oubre Jr. signed a two-year deal with Indiana, and NBC Sports Philadelphia lists Nov 15 as his return. Tyrese Haliburton came back from his torn Achilles this preseason with 'no restrictions.' Sunday 1:00 tip.

2026-11-21.basis: Saturday 1:00 tip. Tyler Herro now plays for Milwaukee (came over in the Giannis trade).

2026-11-23.basis: Portland traded for Ja Morant this summer, and Damian Lillard is back in Portland after missing 2025-26 with a torn Achilles. They played together for the first time in the Oct 7 preseason opener. Thanksgiving is Nov 26. Medium because of both players' injury histories.

2026-11-25.hook: Giannis in a Heat jersey, NBA Cup
2026-11-25.basis: Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee (June 2026), and he's healthy and played preseason. This is an NBA Cup group game (East Group B) on ESPN, the Wednesday before Thanksgiving, 5:00 tip.

2026-12-01.hook: No. 3 pick Cameron Boozer in town
2026-12-01.basis: Memphis drafted Cameron Boozer (Duke) No. 3, and half of NBA GMs picked him for Rookie of the Year in NBA.com's survey. Ja Morant is gone (traded to POR). One of six $75-base games at launch. Medium because it depends on a rookie being healthy in December.

2026-12-02.basis: Nikola Jokic (MVP runner-up last season) still anchors Denver. This is the second night of a Sixers back-to-back (Dec 1 vs MEM), so Embiid could rest; that's why the main hook is about Jokic. NBA TV. The alt is medium.

2026-12-12.hook: Saturday night, play-in rematch vs. Orlando
2026-12-12.basis: The Sixers beat Orlando 109-97 in the April 2026 play-in. The Sixers host the Magic Dec 12 and visit them Dec 14, their only back-to-back series against one team this season.

2026-12-17.hook: Reigning ROY Cooper Flagg in town
2026-12-17.alt: Flagg vs. VJ, ROY race rematch
2026-12-17.basis: Cooper Flagg won 2025-26 Rookie of the Year over Kon Knueppel, with VJ Edgecombe the third finalist. Kyrie Irving is back from his ACL tear (played preseason). NBA TV.

2026-12-23.hook: KD in town, two days before Christmas
2026-12-23.basis: Kevin Durant is on the Rockets (52-30 last season, with Sengun and Amen Thompson). Prime Video national game. It's the Sixers' last home game before their Christmas Day trip to the Lakers.

2027-01-04.alt: Welcome-home game after the West trip
2027-01-04.basis: Dec 23 is the last home game of 2026. Then a five-game road trip (Dec 25 to Jan 1). Jan 4 is the first game back. The Hawks have Jalen Johnson and No. 8 pick Kingston Flemings.

2027-01-06.basis: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander won his second straight MVP (May 2026). The Sixers traded Jared McCain to OKC on Feb 4, 2026. ESPN national game.

2027-01-08.basis: Giannis was traded to Miami (June 2026) to pair with Bam Adebayo. Friday night ESPN national game.

2027-01-12.hook: Dybantsa, Trae and AD in town
2027-01-12.alt: Tuesday night on NBC vs. the Wizards
2027-01-12.basis: Washington drafted AJ Dybantsa No. 1 and now has Trae Young and Anthony Davis (both acquired last season). All three played together this preseason. NBC national game, and one of six $75-base games at launch. Medium because of AD's injury history.

2027-01-14.alt: MPJ and rookie Mikel Brown Jr.
2027-01-14.basis: The Nets are rebuilding (No. 28 in NBA.com's preseason power rankings) with Michael Porter Jr., Julius Randle and No. 6 pick Mikel Brown Jr. (ankle injury this preseason). The alt is medium.

2027-01-16.basis: Minnesota got LaMelo Ball from Charlotte in a four-team trade (July 2026) to pair with Anthony Edwards. Saturday 12:30 tip. MLK Day is Mon Jan 18.

2027-01-19.basis: Haliburton is back from his Achilles tear, and Kelly Oubre Jr. signed with Indiana. The Sixers play at ATL on MLK Day afternoon (Jan 18), so this is the second night of a back-to-back. Medium because Haliburton is coming off a major injury.

2027-01-25.basis: Kawhi (traded to TOR) and Harden (traded to CLE) are both gone. The Clippers are rebuilding around Darius Garland, and Brandon Ingram is out to start the season with a partially torn Achilles. They drafted Keaton Wagler No. 5. One of six $75-base games at launch. The alt is medium.

2027-01-27.basis: Sacramento went 22-60 last season and has Domantas Sabonis, Zach LaVine and No. 7 pick Darius Acuff Jr. Don't pitch Ben Simmons: he signed with the Kings but tore his Achilles Oct 18 and is expected to miss the season. The alt is medium because players could be traded before the Feb 11 deadline.

2027-02-01.basis: Zion Williamson played 62 games last season, and Joe Dumars called him in 'impeccable condition' at media day. Medium because of his injury history. Ex-Sixer Trendon Watford is now a Pelican.

2027-02-05.hook: Friday night vs. Cade, on Prime
2027-02-05.basis: Prime Video national game against the Pistons (last year's East No. 1 seed). Feb 5-11 is the Sixers' longest homestand of the season (four games).

2027-02-07.basis: NBC national game. Jayson Tatum looked healthy this preseason and Paul George is now in Boston. Rematch of last spring's 3-1 comeback series.

2027-02-08.alt: MPJ and the Nets, Monday night
2027-02-08.basis: Second night of a back-to-back (Feb 7 vs BOS) and game 3 of the four-game homestand. The Nets are rebuilding around Michael Porter Jr. and Julius Randle.

2027-02-11.hook: Knicks rivalry on trade deadline day
2027-02-11.basis: NBC Sports Philadelphia notes Feb 11 is the trade deadline. Prime Video national game. The Knicks are defending champions and swept the Sixers last May.

2027-02-17.hook: Booker in town, last game before All-Star
2027-02-17.basis: Devin Booker is still the Suns' centerpiece. All-Star Weekend is Feb 19-21, and the Sixers' next game after Feb 17 is Feb 25.

2027-03-03.hook: Kon Knueppel, ROY runner-up, in town
2027-03-03.basis: Kon Knueppel finished second in Rookie of the Year voting. He's starting the season hurt (hamstring), so this is medium. LaMelo Ball was traded to Minnesota.

2027-03-04.hook: LeBron vs. his old team, plus Luka
2027-03-04.alt: Luka and the Lakers, on Prime
2027-03-04.basis: LeBron left the Lakers for Philly in July 2026, and Luka Doncic leads LA. Ex-Sixers Quentin Grimes and Matisse Thybulle are now Lakers. Prime Video national game. Second night of a back-to-back (Mar 3 vs CHA) (rest risk).

2027-03-08.hook: No. 2 pick Darryn Peterson in town
2027-03-08.basis: Utah drafted Darryn Peterson (Kansas) No. 2. The Jazz also have Jaren Jackson Jr. (from MEM) and Lauri Markkanen. Medium because it depends on a rookie being healthy in March.

2027-03-15.hook: Kawhi and the Raptors, round two
2027-03-15.basis: Kawhi Leonard is back in Toronto (traded this summer). Peacock national game. Medium because Kawhi often sits.

2027-03-17.hook: St. Patrick's Day vs. the Bulls
2027-03-17.basis: The game falls on March 17, St. Patrick's Day. Calendar fact.

2027-03-21.alt: West champs on Sunday night NBC
2027-03-21.basis: The Spurs visit Philly once this season. They're the defending West champs (lost the Finals 4-1 to NYK), and Wembanyama was unanimous DPOY and third in MVP voting. NBC national game. Ex-Sixer Tobias Harris is now a Spur.

2027-03-31.hook: Steph's only Philly stop this year
2027-03-31.alt: Curry plus ex-Sixers Horford and Melton
2027-03-31.basis: The Warriors' only visit to Philly this season. ESPN national game. Al Horford and De'Anthony Melton re-signed with Golden State. Medium because Curry had an ankle scare this preseason and will be 39. Jimmy Butler (ex-Sixer) is targeting a Jan/Feb return from his ACL tear, which is unconfirmed, so don't pitch him.

2027-04-04.basis: Sunday 1:00 tip, one week before the regular season ends. One of six $75-base games at launch.

2027-04-11.alt: Last game of the regular season
2027-04-11.basis: The NBA regular season ends Sunday, April 11, 2027, with all 30 teams playing. The 6:00 tip could shift, since the league often moves final-day start times.
